column1: # cenfuse benchmark, one row per scored chromosome-run: 4376 rows, 316 runs, 73 genomes; cenfuse 0.16.0 (265 runs), 0.16.1 (51 runs). Scored by benchmark/score.py with benchmark/truth.tsv. Read: benchmark/README.md

# Coordinates: 1-based, inclusive throughout (as cenfuse's <genome>.centromeres.tsv); truth start = truth BED start + 1. truth_all = every truth interval of the chromosome (start-end;start-end); truth_start/truth_end = the one the scorer used (nearest to the call, a hit first). '.' = none (no call; no truth on a holocentric genome; a line that did not run)

# truth_start, truth_end, truth_all and kt_on_truth left empty for mPanTro3 mPanPan1 mGorGor1 mPonAbe1 mPonPyg2: the Logsdon lab's curated CDRs (unpublished, contact the lab before publication); outcomes kept
# control: none | random_hic (Hi-C randomized: NEG relocated ends, NEG2 and TNEG re-paired partners) | holocentric (no single centromere: any confident call is wrong) | holocentric+random_hic

# outcome: right_high/right_medium/right_low | conf_wrong (wrong high or medium) | wrong_low | none (no call). Right: score_rule mammal/overlap/active = >= 1 bp overlap with a truth_all interval; gap/bin1 = at most tol_bp bases between call and one; holo = never

# Columns: genome = truth.tsv id; arm = the run's folder (a job-table code; what it holds is in inputs); inputs = read from the run's run_info.json; cen_class = satellite | TE_or_none (LTR/LINE clusters or no repeat) | point_regional (fungi, Plasmodium) | holocentric; truth_kind = truth.tsv kind (agreement = another caller's satellite locus, not truth); all_inputs = 1 on the run the docs count as the genome's all-inputs run; rule = cenfuse's call rule; score_rule, tol_bp = the scorer's rule and tolerance; fam_gate, fam_start, fam_end = the repeat-family line (FASTA) and its window; kt_start, kt_end = the CpG kinetochore; kt_on_truth = inside a truth interval | edge (overlaps one) | no; truth_all = every truth interval (above)
